subject: Frostline incident readout, RCA highlights, and validation checklist
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@frostline.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@frostline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Frostline incident readout, RCA highlights, and validation checklist

Hi Oliver / Sanjay,

Thanks again for the time earlier — following our call, I wanted to share a concise readout so your team has a single document of record. Attached is the one-page RCA summary plus an index of the evidence we've collected. High-level items below.

Summary (TL;DR)
- Incident window: 2026-11-19 22:05 UTC — 2026-11-20 02:40 UTC (partial service degradation for inference requests routed to eu-west-1).
- Impact: increased 5xxs and token-emit latency spikes for 7% of Frostline production traffic; no data leakage identified.
- Root cause (short): a kernel fallback path regression for our Llama-3-70b-quant pipeline combined with a KV-cache eviction race under certain sequence-length distributions.

Timeline (high level)
- 11/19 22:03 UTC: small surge in long-context requests observed by our anomaly detectors.
- 11/19 22:07 UTC: first elevated 5xx alerts from Frostline's routes.
- 11/19 22:30 UTC: automated fallback to compatible model variant triggered; initial mitigation reduced error rate but latency remained elevated.
- 11/20 02:40 UTC: full mitigation deployed (runtime kernel guard and aggressive cache-locking).

Action items (owner / ETA)
1) Runtime hotfix (temporary guard on kernel fallback) — OWNER: Hannah Schmitt — COMPLETED 11/23. See deployment_notes_20261123.txt.
2) Persistent fix (remove race and add unit tests) — OWNER: Marissa Cole — ETA 2026-12-10.
3) Verification plan & acceptance testing with Frostline traffic replay — OWNER: Sean Gallagher / Frostline ops — SCHEDULE: 2026-11-24 verification call.
4) Evidence bundle & audit log export for your compliance team — OWNER: Sean Gallagher — ATTACHED and shared link.

Attachments included: frostline_rca_summary.pdf (1p), evidence_bundle_index.txt (list of artifacts and retention locations), deployment_notes_20261123.txt (hotfix details).

Next step: a 30-minute verification call on Tue 11/24 to replay a subset of traffic with your ops and confirm restored behavior. I've included the shared drive link and a tentative meet link below. If you prefer a different cadence or want a written checklist instead of a call, say the word and we'll adapt.

Apologies for the disruption — we're focused on preventing recurrence and making verification as frictionless as possible for your team.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: frostline_rca_summary.pdf
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@frostline.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Frostline incident readout, RCA highlights, and validation checklist

Sean —

Thanks for the clear summary and the artifacts. A few quick questions before the verification call:
1) Can you confirm whether any PII was present in the evidence logs you shared? We have to loop in compliance if so.
2) Regarding the persistent fix ETA (12/10) — can you break that into milestones so we can coordinate a staged rollback plan if needed?
3) Are there specific query shapes that triggered the KV-cache eviction race? Our engineers want to know whether a client-side mitigation is practical while you ship the PR.

Appreciate the quick response. I'll be on the 11/24 call — Sanjay will lead from our side for the traffic replay.

—Oliver
CTO, Frostline Payments
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@frostline.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@frostline.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Frostline incident readout, RCA highlights, and validation checklist

Oliver — quick answers inline and a milestone breakdown.

1) PII in logs: the attached evidence_bundle_index.txt includes hashed request IDs only. No raw PII is present in the exported runtime logs; we redacted user payloads before export. If you want a signed statement for your auditors we can provide one (we have a standard form).

2) Persistent fix milestones (high level):
  - 11/24–11/26: additional unit & regression tests + internal review.
  - 11/29: PR into main and canary deploy to non-prod.
  - 12/03–12/07: staged prod canary (1% -> 10% -> 50%).
  - 12/10: full prod rollout and post-rollout verification.

3) Query shapes: the race surfaced when long-sequence requests (>6k tokens) interleaved with prefix-append calls that modified the active KV keys during read. Short-term client mitigation: avoid simultaneously issuing large prefix/append sequences during the canary window or route those to a dedicated variant we can provision for you. We'll include a recommended client-side gating snippet in the verification docs.

I've uploaded a short checklist for the replay and pinned it to the Drive link. See you Tuesday.

—Marissa
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: evidence_bundle_index.txt
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver@frostline.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Frostline incident readout, RCA highlights, and validation checklist

On Wed, Nov 24, 2026 at 10:05 AM Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again — the replay went as planned, and the initial metrics looked stable.

Folks — quick update from the runtime side: the hotfix we pushed on 11/23 included a kernel guard that prevents the fallback path from executing while KV-cache write locks are held. We ran a 3-hour synthetic stress run overnight against a traffic shape that mimics Frostline's 95th percentile profile; no reproductions observed.

I've attached the deployment notes (deployment_notes_20261123.txt) with the exact guard logic and the canary roll strategy we used. Next immediate step for us is to convert the guard into a unit-tested codepath and add the regression harness that Marissa mentioned.

Hannah
Senior SW Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: deployment_notes_20261123.txt
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@frostline.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@frostline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Frostline incident readout, RCA highlights, and validation checklist

Oliver / Sanjay —

Thanks again for joining the replay and for the productive verification session. Quick closing notes and asks:
- Verification result: traffic replay showed error rates returned to baseline and p95 token-latency reduced to pre-incident levels during a 60-minute window.
- Next milestones: Marissa will circulate the PR timeline; Hannah will post the regression harness to the shared repo by 11/29.
- Ask: please confirm whether Frostline requires a formal signed assurance statement for the audit. If yes, I will route our compliance team and provide a timeline for delivery.

I'll leave this thread open for any follow-up. If we don't hear back by 12/03 we'll send a short closure packet including the final verification artifact and a post-incident lessons doc.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
